categoryOrderBasis: Editorial broad-use order; not a measured category popularity ranking

recommendations.selection: Topic round robin; favorites, editorial selections and available usage metadata rank within each topic; mix free and paid when available
recommendations.eligibility: Apply search, price and favorites first; exclude disabled/unpriced products and unregistered premium templates
recommendations.pagination: Retain batches of 12 in grid mode; stop remote paging at the recommendation limit
recommendations.networkRegression: Real feed: one initial summary request; repeated all/recommended switches and scrolling to recommendation end issue no additional requests; no full-catalog requests
recommendations.artwork: Metadata only; no recommendation image generation, document parsing or persistent recommendation cache
